liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (1 review): Jerry sang the opening Sugaree with passion [4]
- **Me & My Uncle** (1 review): The Me & My Uncle into Big River pairing is described as good, fun playing [4]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer says the Terrapin Station contains some tasty moments [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **BIODTL**: back after 254 archived shows (1647 days) [14]

## The recordings

- **gd79-01-21.aud.cole.19083.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 151 min; rated 2.74/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader calls the audience recording marginal at best, and says it had DSP processing including EQ; Reviewer finds the audience recording bad, though perhaps tolerable to die-hard audience-tape fans; Reviewer finds the audience recording so poor that they will not listen to it [1][2][9][12][13]

## Around the show

- The uploader says this was their own first Dead show [1]
- The show started an hour late, which was unusual for the band [5]
- At the first break Donna walked to dead microphones; the hall went silent and she asked for quiet [5]
- Reviewer notes the odd setting of the Dead playing Masonic Hall in cold mid-January Detroit [6]
- Reviewer wonders why Donna was absent from this show [6]
- Masonic Auditorium was beautiful but not a rock venue; staff demanded seated audiences, which Deadheads obeyed only briefly [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd79-01-21.aud.cole.19083.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Transfer chain was SHN to WAV, CE2K, CDWAVE, shntool, then mkwACT; edited and seeded to etree by MattMan [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-01-21 Masonic Temple, Detroit, MI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-01-21-masonic-temple-detroit-mi-usa/) [15]
- Poster by theconcertdatabase.com: [The Grateful Dead | The Concert Database](https://theconcertdatabase.com/concerts/grateful-dead-12) [16]
